hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
Shiwa, a Gabonese Bantu A80 language, missing
(**hh:s:Dougere:Chiwa**, **hh:typ:Ollomo:Siwe**, **hh:phontyp:Ollomo:Shiwa**). It is most closely related to Kwasio [nmg], but about equally close to it as any pair of the closest A80 languages with separate E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 entries
(**hh:hv:Cheucle:Makaa-Njem**:516,
**hh:hv:Grollemund:Bantu-Nord-Ouest**). See also: Kwasio [nmg].
